who: Real stack · real mail server · local stand-ins for Stripe, the project tool and storage
title: From "can you help us?" to a signed, paid, set-up project
sub: Proposal from an enquiry, e-signature bound to the exact text, signed PDF, Stripe deposit, and the project, folder and welcome email set up on their own.
outro: Python · FastAPI · SQLite · Stripe Checkout + signed webhooks · fpdf2 · SMTP · Docker · e2e in GitHub Actions.
thumbTitle: Signed, paid and set up, hands off

caps.text: A prospect asks for a proposal on the studio's site
The studio gets a draft built from the package and the options she picked
Adjust a line, then send. She gets a link by email
Lena opens the link. Signing ties her name to the SHA-256 of exactly this text
Signed. The signed PDF is emailed, and she lands on Stripe Checkout for the 30% deposit
Paid. Stripe's signed webhook, not the redirect, marks it paid
Then the setup runs by itself: project with tasks, shared folder, welcome email, through 2 outages
Signature record, deposit, setup steps, and every email: sent, or cancelled because it no longer fit
